title: FlowSpace System Node Graph
product_rule: Visible UI is a shipping claim. Every visible surface and control must resolve to real code, state, authority, persistence, and proof.

nodes.label: System graph freshness and wiring gate
Calendar
nodes.reason: The visible surface is a date picker without event state, persistence, scheduling, or calendar tests.

nodes.label: Connect
nodes.reason: Visible meeting actions require backend endpoints and have no truthful local-mode capability path.

nodes.label: Projects
nodes.reason: Local project/task code exists, but the complete visible journey lacks an isolated integration proof and graph-bound control inventory.

nodes.label: Settings
nodes.reason: The visible settings tree contains null handlers and explicit coming-soon actions.

nodes.label: Streams
nodes.reason: Core read/send paths have local fallback, but visible reactions, threads, pins, and header actions are not locally wired.

nodes.label: Vault
nodes.reason: Listing can fall back to SQLite, but visible upload, delete, and open paths are not a complete local-first contract.

nodes.label: Workspace
nodes.reason: Hard-coded user, workspace, activity, project, progress, and release data plus empty navigation actions.
